reasoning_content:
Both remaining prepare steps succeeded (material-symbol-names was already in cache, version:stamp stamped the dev version). The frontend dependencies are now fully ready:
- pnpm install: complete
- generate:api (25 clients): complete
- generate-map-glyphs: complete
- generate-material-symbol-names: complete
- version:stamp: complete

All prerequisites are in place. Now, let's execute the real `just up`. The plan:
- `GITHUB_TOKEN=<dummy> just up` — instance is "workspace" (pre-created), seed defaults to yes (DB is in initial state and non-TTY)
- `--detach` is not allowed (dev servers are part of the stack) — run in full
- Run in the background using setsid so it persists
- Steps: pnpm install (now fast), start dev servers, compose create --build (backend image build → reuse cache → fast; all other images are local), attach proxy, up -d --wait, seed

One concern: compose's `create --build` builds the backend image. Since I built it as `urbo-backend-test` with a manual build, compose will rebuild with its own tag, but the BuildKit cache will be reused → fast.

Alright, let's get started.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/just-up.log
setsid nohup just up > /tmp/just-up.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo "just up pid $!"
sleep 30; echo "=== log ==="; tail -30 /tmp/just-up.log
